blocks.html: A Sales Development Representative (SDR) is a sales professional primarily responsible for prospecting, qualifying inbound and outbound leads, initiating conversations, and booking meetings for account executives or senior sales staff.

SDRs play an important role in the early stages of the sales process by identifying potential buyers and creating qualified opportunities for closing teams. Their focus is on outreach, lead qualification, and keeping the sales pipeline active.

items.html: Contacting leads through calls, emails, and social channels
Qualifying prospects based on fit and buying intent
Updating CRM records and activity notes

blocks.html: SDRs help bridge the gap between marketing-generated interest and revenue-generating sales conversations.
Allows account executives to focus on closing deals
An SDR reaches out to webinar attendees, qualifies interested prospects, and books product demo meetings for the account executive team.
A Sales Development Representative (SDR) is a pipeline-building sales role focused on prospecting, lead qualification, and setting meetings that create new business opportunities.
Build a stronger pipeline with expert outreach. MarketJoy helps businesses scale SDR programs that generate qualified leads and book more meetings.
